Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Full-bleed cinematic space background for StarChain, landscape 16:9, requested output approximately 2560 x 1440 pixels.
Primary request: Generate a NEW cinematic cosmos environment background, using the supplied screenshot only as a visual style and composition reference. Reconstruct the rich, sharp, detailed background of that reference with ALL interface graphics and spacecraft absent.
Input image role: Style/layout reference only. Do not reproduce its UI, cards, text, borders, spacecraft, beams, shields, or symbols.
Scene/backdrop: Deep navy blue outer space with a dimensional starfield and luminous blue-cyan cosmic dust. An enormous detailed Earth-like planet occupies the lower half, viewed from orbit; a glowing blue atmospheric rim curves diagonally from the left around 42 percent image height, sweeping gradually downward to the right around 64 percent height. Across the planet's night-side continents are delicate, realistic amber city lights, dark blue oceans, and volumetric cloud patterns. Rich purple-blue nebula clouds concentrate in the upper right quadrant. A distant dark rocky planet is situated near the upper right at roughly 72 percent across and 14 percent down, with a softly illuminated crescent rim. Sparse irregular sharp rocky asteroids frame the extreme left and right outer edges and lower corners, with a few tiny distant rocks for depth.
Composition/framing: Wide expansive environment; preserve clear negative space throughout the central upper half for two large opposing spaceship assets that will be composited separately. Keep the central 65 percent free from large rocks. Earth is a grand background arc extending beyond the frame, not a small isolated globe. Detailed luminous textured lower surface extends to bottom edge. The top is deep space. Do not add a frame.
Style/medium: High-end realistic cinematic science-fiction game environment art with very fine atmospheric, cloud, rock, and starlight detail; crisp natural dimensional rendering, physically plausible atmosphere, strong scale.
Lighting/mood: Match the source's rich contrast: luminous cyan Earth horizon, blue nebula light, violet cosmic cloud glow, warm amber lights. Deep navy shadows retain visible layered texture and detail. Vibrant but coherent.
Constraints: ONLY the environment. Absolutely no ships, spacecraft, weapons, lasers, explosions, shields, UI, HUD, grids, cards, numbers, letters, text, labels, logos, watermark, border, or vignette that hides details. Do not make a flat generic dark starfield. No large objects in the central upper-half negative space. Keep full bleed.
